Rules.InvariantScript:
"data:image/svg+xml;utf8," & EncodeUrl(
  "<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 640 640'><polyline fill='none' stroke='#4FC3F7' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' points='" &
  Concat(
    Sequence(ctxLisN),
    With(
      {t: 2 * Pi() * Value / 600},
      Text(320 + 290 * Sin(sldLisA.Value * t + Radians(sldLisDelta.Value)), "0.0") & "," &
      Text(320 + 290 * Sin(sldLisB.Value * t), "0.0")
    ),
    " "
  ) &
  "'/></svg>"
)
